analyst.summary: Aarti Pharmalabs makes pharmaceutical intermediates and active ingredients. Revenue has held roughly steady over the past year, but profitability has weakened noticeably -- full-year profit is down about 31% and operating margins have contracted by roughly 800 basis points, largely on pricing pressure in the intermediates business. The balance sheet itself is healthy (comfortable debt levels, strong interest coverage), so this is a margin story rather than a solvency one, but the current valuation does not yet reflect that margin reset.
